annotations.title: Check whether a fix is done

description: Re-check ONE item now and say whether it is done, with the reason: a site check (robots.txt, firewall, structured data, llms.txt and the rest), or one already-audited page of your site (its title, meta description, headings, AI-readiness checks). It reads your public site through Goppa's safe fetcher and uses no AI and buys no data. It records nothing and marks nothing done: Goppa confirms fixes itself on the next check. Items it cannot check this way say so.

item.description: The item to check: a guide step id, a site check id (a1 to e3), a site audit problem code or an AI-readiness check id.

site.description: One of your sites in Goppa, by domain (example.com). Required when the account has more than one site: without it, the answer lists the sites to choose from. With a single site it can be left out.

url.description: For a page check: a page of this site that the last site audit listed (get_site_audit or get_page_score).

name: verify_fix
title: Check whether a fix is done
